anchor.selector: section.flex.flex-col:nth-of-type(2) > div.overflow-hidden.rounded-2xl > div.p-0 > div.eh-root > div.eh-stage:nth-of-type(1) > span.eh-hub:nth-of-type(7) > span.eh-hub-body > span.eh-hub-pulse:nth-of-type(1)

messages.body: Vamos fazer um outro ícone para cohort. Algo relacionado à sala de aula.

Done in Hi-Fi/_ui/EmptyStateHuddle.vue: the tile now takes a hub, and Cohorts get a classroom instead of the stacked hands: a board with chalk writing above three desks with empty chairs. The board drops in, the seats come up and the chalk writes; on each pulse the seats hop and the lesson is wiped and written again. It shows wherever a Cohort is the place: No Cohorts yet (Team Owner, Team Manager) and No learners yet (Cohort Owner, Facilitator). Teams keep the hands. The choice per role is in _ui/emptyStates.ts.
